# `integration_migrate_provenance_refs`

**Move Git provenance out of branches.** Local operator copies and verifies immutable provenance refs before deleting legacy heads.

## Purpose

Move existing completion and replacement evidence from `refs/heads/aq-provenance/*`
to `refs/aq/provenance/*` while retaining the exact Git objects and source history.

## When a playbook uses it

This is a local operator migration. Playbook and worker principals are refused.
Normal completion writers already use the new namespace.

## How it works internally

The [handler](../../../src/commands/integration_commands.py) resolves the project's
designated repository. [ProvenanceMigration](../../../src/integration/provenance_migration.py)
inventories legacy refs in a temporary authenticated checkout, validates their
metadata and immutable identity, copies absent destination refs, verifies their
remote OIDs, and deletes each old branch under its observed exact-OID lease.

## Side effects and persistence

Preview leaves durable refs, configuration, indexes and database rows untouched.
Apply changes remote Git refs; `--checkout` additionally moves legacy local heads
in that checkout. No database migration or delivery-state change is involved.
Partial transfers can be resumed by repeating apply; identical destinations are kept.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

`blocked` reports per-ref errors: invalid records, conflicting destinations,
failed copies, changed old refs or attached local branches. Old refs remain in
place when their copy cannot be verified. `refused` identifies authority,
repository or Git setup failures. Preview the same page to inspect its rows.
`remaining` counts remote legacy refs left after this page; reduce `--limit` on
slow repositories, and repeat apply until it reaches zero. Resolve blocked rows
before repeating a page they fill.

## Example step

Run from the operator CLI:

```bash
aq integration migrate-provenance-refs PROJECT --limit 50
aq integration migrate-provenance-refs PROJECT --apply --limit 50
aq integration migrate-provenance-refs PROJECT --apply --checkout /path/to/checkout
```
